ns2:course.label: Graphic Design Practicum
ns2:course.description: This analytical studio prepares students for entry into the field of graphic design. Professional practice is parsed into areas of opportunity, to which students ultimately align themselves and by which they structure their preparatory endeavors. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: ARTD 418 and ARTD 444.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: ARTD 418 and ARTD 444.
